title: trRosetta releases over 6,300 predicted protein-family structures
summary: Over 6,300 protein structures predicted with deep learning are available in Pfam to explore families without a known structure. These are computational models with estimated quality, not newly experimentally determined structures; this result is distinct from RoseTTAFold and the AlphaFold Database.

evidence.tested: Pfam models are scored with lDDT (0.6 or higher considered reasonable); the article describes no independent validation.
evidence.unknown: The article does not state limitations and says more structures are to follow.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning trRosetta predicted structures for protein families.
